other.title: Compound duration format for deploy logs
other.firstAsk: Change of plan on the compound format. The deploy logs it's meant for get scraped by a Go service that runs every duration through `time.ParseDuration`, and that rejects spaces and has no `d` unit. So compound output has to be ParseDuration-compatible: parts glued together and hours as the biggest unit, e.g. `25h30m` rather than `1d 1h 30m`. Don't change it right now though, something more urgent…
other.summary: Makes parse() tolerate padded YAML values and documents and tests the compound format. The compound output still uses spaces, so it is not yet ParseDuration-compatible.
